scope: Independently derived source metadata; no private implementation imported/executed or body published
inputAndScope: Required primitive nonblank client selector trims and slices to80 UTF16 units. Source accepts UUID identity or client name; no pagination or limit input is consumed.

Visibility helper queries tenantId, excludes archived client status, resolves UUID directly or case-insensitive exact name with ambiguity refusal. No actor or client-wall predicate is present in this helper.
Tracking owner uses withTenant(tenantId), where clientId, createdAt descending; no take or limit. Global congressional enrichment is separate and does not rebind tracking tenant.

Meri adds explicit binding/subject/clientReference context and binding/subject/data wrapper. These are trusted adapter assertions, not old producer fields or proof of current visibility. No connected context producer is supplied in this family.
Raw UUID can be correlated case-insensitively to canonical subject UUID. Name-to-ID resolution must remain external; pure contracts must not invent a resolver or locale equivalence.
outerProjection: Raw data has tool,generatedAt,clientId,total,bills. Total is bills.length, not corpus size or legislative relevance.
Each row has id,billId,note,createdAt,bill. Actual Prisma-returned nullable note is present; global bill lookup miss yields bill:null while tracking row remains.

TrackedBill.id is UUID primary key; clientId is UUID; unique(clientId,billId) supports row-ID and per-client bill-ID uniqueness. billId is otherwise stored String, not a forced canonical federal designation.
Creation timestamp is general DateTime, descending with ties unconstrained. It is not latest legislative action chronology.
globalProjection: Title and identifier are stored strings; latestActionText,status,sponsorName,sponsorParty nullable. No enum or status-label computation exists.
latestActionDate is nullable SQLDate; canonical Date wire representation is midnight UTC. Outer createdAt and generatedAt are instants with time of day.
actionTexts is SQL ARRAY of action text, no imposed output limit; no chronological order can be inferred from opaque text. subjectNames uses stored subjects with empty-array fallback.

Arrays preserve duplicates/empty strings; no title truncation,50-row cap, pagination or coverage fields are introduced. Generic canonical resource limits may refuse oversized JSON; they cannot silently truncate.
gates: Source controller standard_user RolesGuard and configurable tool service-secret guard remain external. Canonical subject lineage is shape/correlation validation, not live actor/client wall enforcement.
No tracking write or provider call observed in this selected read path, but actual database connection, tenant isolation, fresh scope, query semantics and release reauthorization remain UNRUN.
Family remains private source-only and disconnected until separately reviewed canonical integration; all original source-disabled/public/catalog/runtime state preserved.
